purpose: Bounded expansion of the Issue 55 reliability sample across completed splits, active listing pressure, going concern, foreign-filer/ADR, and OTC/delisted behavior.

provider_policy.note: Alpha Vantage is first; configured Twelve Data is bounded fallback. SEC/Nasdaq evidence survives optional-provider failure. No paid provider is authorized.

cases.identity: Biora Therapeutics, Inc. common stock, Nasdaq Global Market, ticker BIOR, CIK 1580063; formerly Progenity, Inc.
known_baseline: Completed 1-for-10 reverse split effective October 18, 2024; proposal/authorization and completion must not be double-counted.
October 2024 registered direct issuance and concurrent warrants are material capital-structure evidence.
Current prospective reverse-split risk must be distinct from completed historical actions.
severe_miss_conditions: Either completed reverse split is omitted or presented only as prospective.

cases.identity: Mullen Automotive Inc. common stock, Nasdaq Capital Market, ticker MULN, CIK 1499961; formerly Net Element, Inc.
known_baseline: Completed reverse splits include 1-for-25 in May 2023, 1-for-9 in August 2023, 1-for-100 in December 2023, 1-for-100 in September 2024, and 1-for-100 effective June 2, 2025.
The repeated splits were undertaken in substantial part to address Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance.
The June 2025 quarterly filing disclosed then-current Market Value of Listed Securities listing pressure; historical regained-compliance language must not erase an active notice.
Repeated financing and extreme split history support material capital-structure risk.
severe_miss_conditions: Repeated completed split history is materially omitted.
Active listing pressure is described as resolved solely from older language.
Missing or stale financial evidence becomes favorable.

cases.filing_regime: foreign private issuer using 20-F/6-K and IFRS as issued by IASB
cases.identity: NIO Inc. NYSE-listed American depositary shares, ticker NIO, CIK 1736541; each ADS represents one Class A ordinary share; Cayman Islands issuer.
known_baseline: The security is an NYSE-listed ADS/ADR interest, not domestic common stock.
The issuer files annual 20-F and current 6-K reports rather than domestic 10-K/10-Q reports.
2024 revenue increased 18.2% to RMB65,731.6 million while net loss widened 8.1% to RMB22,401.7 million.
RMB, IFRS concepts, ADS ratio, and annual/6-K cadence must remain explicit and comparable; unavailable domestic-style trends must remain Limited.
severe_miss_conditions: NIO is represented as domestic common stock or wrong issuer evidence is merged.
RMB/IFRS/cadence mismatch produces a favorable score.
The widening loss is described as improving.

cases.filing_regime: domestic SEC reporting lineage; NYSE security suspended/delisted and moved to OTC Expert Market after Chapter 11
cases.identity: Tupperware Brands Corporation common stock, former NYSE ticker TUP, OTC Expert Market ticker TUPBQ, CIK 1008654.
known_baseline: Tupperware and subsidiaries filed voluntary Chapter 11 petitions on September 17, 2024.
NYSE suspended the former TUP security and commenced delisting; the security moved to the OTC Expert Market as TUPBQ.
The 2022 auditor report contained substantial doubt about ability to continue as a going concern.
Late/missing periodic reporting and bankruptcy make stale financial trends unsafe for favorable scoring.
severe_miss_conditions: The security is shown as ordinarily active on NYSE or Nasdaq.
Chapter 11 or going-concern distress is omitted.
TUP/TUPBQ lineage or issuer identity is wrong.

completion_rule: Do not close Issue 55 unless the aggregate reliability gates pass, no severe misleading miss remains, and remaining sparse categories are adequately demonstrated or owner-accepted outside milestone scope.
